findings: An infiltrative pancreatic cancer measuring 39 mm is observed in the head of the pancreas. Serosal invasion and retropancreatic tissue invasion are noted. There is contact of more than 180° with the portal vein, suggesting invasion. No invasion beyond the inferior border of the duodenum is observed. No other local invasion factors are identified. Lymph node metastases are observed in one node at station 8a and two nodes at station 14t. No other metastases are observed.
